system.description: Each time the party returns to a community you have history with, generate two things: one NPC from your past (ally, debtor, or rival — your choice of type), and one complication arising from your presence (a debt called in, a bounty, a contact the wrong people know about). The GM and player agree the specifics; the complication is mandatory.
